opening.argument: The promotional nature of this material is disclosed: it is identified as an advertorial, separate from Cryptonews.com editorial content. The message discusses a possible increase in HUMP's price and directs viewers to buy the token, but it also states that no particular outcome is guaranteed. Those facts show a cryptocurrency promotion, not evidence that viewers were deceived or that any transaction or loss occurred. The separate KuCoin banner is not shown to be connected to the HUMP discussion. The purchase invitation warrants scrutiny, but the available evidence does not establish more than the disclosed promotion.
